title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI hooks + quality gating improvements
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: per-prompt gating has become critical as we expand customer prompt coverage. This PR strengthens the eval-harness CI hooks to run per-prompt metrics, add flexible failure thresholds, and surface quality regression details in CI artifacts. Summary of changes: 1) introduce per_prompt_runner that parallelizes prompt-level evaluations and reports metrics per-prompt_id; 2) add configurable quality gates (precision/recall/semantic-similarity thresholds) with linear keys and environment overrides; 3) improve CI hook integration so GitHub checks store attachments (CSV/JSON) with failing prompt buckets; 4) add lightweight sampler to limit expensive evals on feature branches and enforce full runs on release/*; 5) update docs and examples. Checklist: - [x] unit tests for per_prompt_runner - [x] integration test for CI hook upload - [x] docs and examples updated - [x] Linear tasks linked - [x] rollout plan (gradual) Testing and rollout: ran full eval-harness suite on staging (staging-eval cluster) and a trimmed run on feature branch. For release, default gate is soft (warn) for non-blocking branches and hard (block) for release/* and main. See release_notes for gating specifics.
commits_summary: 4 commits: (1) add per_prompt_runner and core per-prompt metrics plumbing, (2) implement gating config and threshold evaluation, (3) CI hook: upload failing_prompt_buckets as artifact and update GH check output, (4) docs + tests + small lint fixes.
changed_files_list: eval-harness/core/per_prompt_runner.py - new module implementing per-prompt parallel runner and metric aggregation
ci/hooks/eval_gating_hook.py - enhancements to upload artifacts and emit structured check summaries
eval-harness/config/gating.yaml - new config schema for per-prompt thresholds and policies
tests/eval_harness/test_per_prompt_runner.py - unit tests for runner parallelism and metric correctness
docs/eval-harness/gating.md - documentation for quality gates and CI behavior
examples/eval-harness/ci-sample-workflow.yaml - example GH workflow demonstrating soft vs hard gates
review_comments: Miguel Alvarez (2026-02-19): Nice direction. Can you add a short-circuit so very large prompt-sets don't overwhelm the staging cluster? Suggest a configurable sampler with max_prompts param.
Asha Patel (2026-02-19): Added sampler config, default to 200 prompts on feature branches. See eval-harness/config/gating.yaml and example workflow.
Hannah Li (2026-02-20): Two nits: 1) prefer GH check annotations for top N failing prompts instead of full CSV inline; 2) tests: assert deterministic ordering for aggregated metrics.
Asha Patel (2026-02-20): Switched GH check to include top-20 table in the check summary and still upload full CSV as artifact. Tests updated for stable ordering by prompt_id.

Samir Gupta (2026-02-21): Performance question: per_prompt_runner parallelism defaults to cpu_count but we run on GPU workers for some evals. Can we make a mode that batches model evals to reduce comp overhead?
Asha Patel (2026-02-21): Added 'batch_mode' option that groups prompts into micro-batches for GPU-based eval nodes. Default off for CPU nodes, on for GPU nodes. Benchmarks attached in CI artifacts.
ci_notes: Initial run showed flakiness for a long-running integration on 2026-02-20 which was traced to a staging config mismatch; rerun on 2026-02-21 passed. Artifacts uploaded: failing_prompts_top20.csv, per_prompt_metrics.json, gating_summary.md.
release_notes:
- Add per-prompt evaluation runner to compute metrics by prompt_id and enable per-prompt quality gating.
- CI hook enhancements: top-N failing prompts surfaced in GH check; full artifacts uploaded for inspection.
- Configurable soft/hard gate policies (default soft on feature branches, hard on release/* and main).
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: noisy gates may cause developer friction. Mitigation: default to soft gates on non-release branches, and provide clear actionable artifacts + guidance; rollout with monitoring for 2 weeks.
qa_summary: Unit + integration tests added (coverage + edge cases). Staging run against core prompt-set (2.1k prompts) verified metric stability and gating behavior. Performance: batch_mode reduced GPU eval time by ~30% in internal microbenchmarks.
notes_for_release_engineering: Ensure gating.yaml is deployed to staging with default sampler limits before enabling on release branches. Update ops playbook to triage failing_prompt_buckets artifacts.
